caption: : Avg. performance across 11 datasets (y-axis) consistently improves as the number of training examples increases (x-axis). Max is 29k examples, the full size of our dataset.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of training dataset examples and average performance across eleven datasets. The x-axis, labeled “# of training dataset (k)”, represents the size of the training dataset in thousands, ranging from 5k to 30k, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5k. The y-axis, labeled “Average Performance”, ranges from 48 to 56, with no specified units. A single solid black line with circular markers connects data points, showing a consistent upward trend: performance starts at 48 when the dataset size is 5k, rises to 50 at 10k, increases to approximately 52.5 at 20k, and reaches its maximum value of 56 at 30k.
